logging.basicConfig\(level=logging.INFO, format='%\(asctime\)s %\(name\)s %\(levelname\)s %\(message\)s', stream=sys.stdout\)

from akshare_mcp.services.strategy_factory import get_strategy_factory_scheduler

async def main\(\):
    factory = get_strategy_factory_scheduler\(\)
    status = factory.status\(\)
    print\(f'=== Factory Status Before Start ==='\)
    for k,v in status.items\(\):
        if k != 'last_result':
            print\(f'  {k}: {v}'\)

    factory.start\(\)
    print\(f'\\\\n=== Factory Started, waiting for cycles... ===\\\\n'\)

    await asyncio.sleep\(900\)

asyncio.run\(main\(\)\)
